packet_dag.terminal_condition: Super Admin can clearly filter BNA/Shloimie versus Rabbi/One Time email in Operations and can open an audited provider-session view of the One Time portal without exposing Rabbi's password.

title: One Time Admin Mailbox Filter And Provider Login

reasons: Operator asked for clear mailbox filtering and active-inbox visibility.
Operator asked for an account/admin login path that mirrors Rabbi's provider view.
The work touches private email, provider account sessions, and Super Admin scope.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time provider portal entry state
likely_external_provider_blockers: None for viewing/filtering; no email send is authorized in this packet.
Reply or campaign sends remain governed by existing Resend readiness and explicit SEND_RESEND_EMAIL gates.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Implement the scoped Super Admin inbox filter and audited provider-session open path.

operator_intent_summary: Shloimie needs to see Rabbi/One Time email from Super Admin with an obvious inbox filter, and also needs a separate admin-on-provider way to see the provider portal exactly as Rabbi sees it.
raw_quotes: I also need to be able to see these emails from the super admin account
a very clear filter in order for me to filter his emails versus my emails
log in and see like his account and see what he's seeing
I'm supposed to be an admin on his account aside from the super admin

decisions_captured.decision: Use an audited Super Admin-opened scoped provider session instead of duplicating or exposing Rabbi's password.

out_of_scope: No email send or bulk campaign send.
No provider password disclosure or password reset.
No payment/access, DNS/provider, Drive, WhatsApp, Telegram, Stripe, Vimeo, Zoom, or external CRM mutation.
No unrelated BNA school, parent, student, provider, platform, or private records in Rabbi provider portal.
affected_surfaces: Operations One Time provider admin entry action

inspection_targets: Existing provider mailbox API is provider-session gated and scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.
Existing View as Rabbi signed token path is read-only and already registered.
Operations Email Workspace renders drafts/logs but needs a clearer inbox selector and active inbox label.
Provider portal already supports a read-only view-as banner but needs an admin-on-provider session banner.
known_blockers: Live deployment and authenticated live smoke are required before Done.

expanded_phrases.clear filter: An explicit inbox selector, active inbox label, counts, and no ambiguous mixed rows.
expanded_phrases.which inbox I'm viewing: A persistent status card/pill naming BNA/Shloimie or Rabbi/One Time plus workspace/project keys.
expanded_phrases.log in like him: A scoped provider-session view with the same provider portal routes/modules as Rabbi, not a global Super Admin page.
expanded_phrases.admin on his account: A Super Admin-only audited admin-on-provider entry point that does not expose Rabbi's password.

requirements.statement: Add clear Super Admin inbox filtering for BNA/Shloimie versus Rabbi/One Time email.
requirements.expected_result: Operations Email Workspace shows an inbox selector and filters records/drafts to the active inbox scope.
acceptance_criteria: Active inbox label names workspace/project and email identity.
Rabbi/One Time option filters to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.
BNA/Shloimie option filters to the BNA/default workspace and does not mix One Time rows.

requirements.statement: Add Super Admin-opened scoped provider portal session.
requirements.expected_result: Super Admin can open the One Time provider portal as admin-on-provider without printing Rabbi's password.
acceptance_criteria: Provider portal uses normal provider session APIs and sections.
Provider portal shows an admin-on-provider banner and no global Super Admin controls.

requirements.expected_result: Registry and tests cover new controls and block wrong-scope/anonymous access.
acceptance_criteria: No provider password appears in code/evidence.

criteria: Raw intake and requirement register exist.
Work is scoped to mailbox filtering and provider-session entry.
External sends and password disclosure are out of scope.
Existing provider mailbox and view-as routes were inspected.
